lead_raw_text:
The structure of Eu4In4Sn8 (EuInSn2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: each Eu and In center has eight Sn neighbors, while each Sn center has four Eu and four In neighbors, all at 3.199 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Sn–Sn polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing, while Eu–In polyhedra share edges, and Eu–Eu and In–In polyhedra share corners.
